mapper.sql: l.id, l.user_id, l.book_id, l.status, l.borrowed_at, l.due_at, l.returned_at, b.format AS book_format, b.title AS book_title, b.author AS book_author, b.issue AS book_issue
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan (user_id, book_id, status, borrowed_at, due_at, active_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{status}, #{borrowedAt}, #{dueAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM loan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE loan SET status = 'RETURNED', returned_at = #{now}, active_key = id WHERE id = #{loanId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM loan l JOIN book b ON b.id = l.book_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY l.due_at ASC, l.id ASC
